name: 关键业务场景可验收覆盖率
argv: import json,pathlib,sys; p=pathlib.Path(sys.argv[1]); x=json.loads((p/'coverage-review.json').read_text()); s=json.loads((p/'acceptance-scenarios.json').read_text()); groups={a['group'] for a in s}; rows={a['id']:a for a in x['groups']}; assert groups==set(rows) and len(groups)==37; passed=sum(rows[g]['verdict']=='PASS' and set(rows[g]['reviewed_branch_ids'])=={a['id'] for a in s if a['group']==g} for g in groups); print(json.dumps({'qualified_groups':passed,'total_groups':len(groups),'definition_coverage_percent':passed/len(groups)*100,'review_status':x['review_status'],'execution_status':'not_run'},ensure_ascii=False))
window: 本轮Gate 1锁定范围至Gate 2独立审查结果

limitations: 未评审为不可判定；PENDING条目未计入分子，不代表该场景缺失或运行失败；不计算生产成功率
